changes.title: ELC EVEN THE WOT TRIO HALLOWEEN

current.changeLog: Fixed skin vanising at long distance.

previous.changeLog:
Shown next to PMOD and XVM, which Aslain's modpack and ProMod install. Their changes to the battle's team lists had kept the charge levels from the mod, so nothing showed.
The offset now goes up to 160 px, far enough to clear the HP bars that other side-panel mods draw beside the tanks.
When nothing could be shown in an Onslaught battle, game.log now says why.

current.changeLog:
The mod is one file now, with its own version and its own updates. It no longer needs Gunmarks Core: once every Gunmarks mod you have is updated, delete app.gunmarks.core_0.1.1.wotmod.
New setting, Place: the Role Skills after the tank icon, or before it, between the tank's name and its icon.
The offset now goes from -400 to 400 px.
The preview shows the side panel in the size you use in battle, with a switch for its other sizes.
The settings page has a tab for each Gunmarks mod, under its name, and lists each with its own version.
The notice of a new version lists each of your mods that has one, with the version you have and the new one.
The garage panel no longer stays on top of the equipment, shells and consumables screens.

previous.changeLog:
No longer switches off XVM's markers. When another mod brings vehicle markers of its own, the mod leaves the markers to it and the settings page says why.
Steadier next to other mods that change the game's markers, whichever starts first.

current.changeLog:
Your session beside your rating, in the garage and in battle: the rating you won or lost over your battles since you started playing.
Battle panel: a setting shows your last battles with Alt, always or never.
The mod is one file now, with its own version and its own updates. It no longer needs Gunmarks Core: once every Gunmarks mod you have is updated, delete app.gunmarks.core_0.1.1.wotmod.

The notice of a new version lists each of your mods that has one, with the version you have and the new one.

current.changeLog:
The mod is one file now, app.gunmarks.moe_0.2.0.wotmod, with its own version and updates: delete the old app.gunmarks.randoms_0.1.1.wotmod and, once every Gunmarks mod you have is updated, app.gunmarks.core_0.1.1.wotmod. Your settings and recorded battles are carried over.
Garage panel: your moving average, what your last battle and your session did to the MoE, and a Goal section (the average damage to reach a mark in 10, 20 or 50 battles).
MoE history: a page of its own with your recorded battles by tank and by session, a tank's MoE as a chart, and what each mark takes.
Battle panel: your damage and assisted damage apart, green above your average; your average and each kind of assistance with Alt.
Settings: a tab for each Gunmarks mod under its name; a switch for every line of both panels, with a preview of each.
The garage panel no longer stays on top of the equipment, shells and consumables screens.

previous.changeLog: Darkens the statistics-page background, corrects Tier XI shell-damage upgrade values, and prevents duplicate engine-fire-chance tooltip entries after repeatedly toggling the fire concealment penalty.

current.changeLog: Keeps sandbox changes when the drawer is reopened, adds resolved Tier XI upgrade descriptions, and shows BV-111 External Ammo Feed shell damage and speed values with matching upgrade previews.

previous.changeLog:
- Updated the installer for World of Tanks 2.4.0.1.
- Supporters can create highlights from a button below the battle rewards, when in-game requests are enabled.
- Get an in-game notification when your highlight is ready, with a link to watch it.
- The linked mod syncs your exact Marks of Excellence percentage, crew skills and equipment to your private Statistics and replay details.
- See your exact Marks of Excellence change for new Random Battles.

current.changeLog:
Added personal Onslaught Rating and statistics tracking.
Added battle-start Loadout capture for ammunition, consumables, directives, field modifications, and vehicle upgrades.
Combined replay uploads, Loadout capture, and Onslaught tracking into one mod.
Moved settings to ModMenu, included in the ZIP.
- found a dumb logic and make it smarter

Added GIF and animated WebP support for custom camouflages and projection decals, with animated previews and playback in the hangar, Exterior, and battles. Also improved loading for long animations and fixed duplicate custom assets.
Made the crosshair ballistics overlay move smoothly while dragging.
Version 1.0.12 comes with removed reticle lock during shooting which happens for roughly 150 ms (it is vanilla WoT normal logic) due to it being too much noticeable with this mod.
